## Où j'en suis
Terraform work for the PostgreSQL 17 upgrade on the analytics RDS is done and plan-only: postgres17 parameter group with derived family, blue/green enabled on staging (16.4 → 17.2), prod prepared but disabled behind `pg17_enabled = false`, AWS provider pinned, tflint clean. Draft PR kestrel-analytics/infra#57 is open and nothing has been applied; the pg_partman upgrade and the prod window remain.

- [en-cours] Draft PR #57 open, staging plan clean (1 add, 1 change), prod plan shows no changes
- [prochaine-étape] Upgrade pg_partman 4.7.4 → 5.1.0 on staging (16.4) and check `run_maintenance_proc()` on `events_raw` / `events_daily` before any apply
- [prochaine-étape] Pick the prod window after Maya's sign-off, avoiding the dbt lock on `events_daily` (01:00–03:30 UTC); candidate slots are Sat/Sun 04:00–06:00 UTC
- [essai-raté] `terraform init` failed on the lock file (aws 5.31.0 vs `>= 5.60.0`); `init -upgrade` pulled provider v6 with 37 unrelated changes, so it was rolled back to 5.82.x
- [décision] Pin the AWS provider to `~> 5.82.0`, no v6 in this PR (source: t04)
- [décision] No prod date until Maya signs off, `apply_immediately` stays false (source: t14)
